decisions.reason: Standalone audio and web conferencing has become highly commoditised and weakly differentiated versus the firm's core network and infrastructure strengths, so resources are better redirected to integrated connectivity and cloud services.

Metropolitan data-centre connectivity is close to the firm's core assets and strategy around cloud, low-latency performance and high-bandwidth enterprise infrastructure, with prior evidence of real adoption.

A voice number ordering portal supports automation, self-service and real-time provisioning, which improves efficiency and fits the firm's software-defined service direction even in a mature voice market.

Direct voice network connection remains useful for enterprise customers as part of managed communications and migration paths, although declining growth in traditional voice makes it less secure than data-centric services.
